en: Black‑and‑white view of a landscaped square with flower beds and trees in the foreground and ornate Renaissance‑style brick buildings in the background. At center is a tall, richly decorated hotel or commercial building with dormer roofs, finials and a large central gable bearing an inscription. Ground‑floor shopfronts include a restaurant and other businesses. To the right stands a monumental stone gate or archway adorned with reliefs and pinnacles. People in late‑19th‑ or early‑20th‑century clothing walk or stand near the buildings.
